@tubi 🎬 “Sidelined 3: End Game premieres free on Tubi November 26”
Sidelined 3: End Game brings the romantic drama franchise to its highly anticipated finale, continuing the emotional journey of Drayton Lahey and Dallas Bryan as they face a new chapter in their relationship. With love, personal ambitions, and their futures at stake, the couple must navigate difficult decisions that could change their lives forever. As familiar faces return and Skyler becomes part of the story, the final installment promises more romance, emotional moments, complicated relationships, and challenges that will test the characters’ bonds. Starring Noah Beck as Drayton, Siena Agudong as Dallas, and Charlie Gillespie as Skyler, alongside Drew Ray Tanner, Kolton Stewart, Sage Linder, Asia Lizardo, and Jason Fernandes, the film brings the beloved characters together for one final chapter about love, loyalty, growing up, and choosing what matters most.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama

📅 Release Date: November 26, 2026

🎥 Director: Michael Medico

🎬 Franchise: Third and final installment of the Sidelined series.

source_details.synopsis: Sidelined 3: End Game is an upcoming American romantic comedy film. Directed by Michael Medico, the film is the sequel to Sidelined 2: Intercepted (2025) and the third and final installment in the Sidelined trilogy. Siena Agudong, Noah Beck and Charlie Gillespie reprise their roles.
